component_attribution.reason: Aggregate gap mixes ETF path/basis, intraday timing, cash/whole-share effects, fees/slippage and other implementation differences. Current evidence cannot causally allocate the residual.

semantics: Replay is a close-to-close exposure approximation. Paper uses intraday fills, TQQQ/QQQ holdings, whole shares, cash, fees, slippage and corporate actions. Gap measures model-to-paper divergence, not broker execution alpha.
